descriptions.Agent output: What the agent says or writes back to the user: a response, a plan, a report, findings, a question, a claim.
descriptions.Agent output > Response / message: An assistant response or a message from the agent.
descriptions.Agent output > Plan: A plan that the agent makes.
descriptions.Agent output > Report / summary: A report, a summary or a status update from the agent.
descriptions.Agent output > Findings: Review findings, issues found, or recommendations from the agent.
descriptions.Agent output > Question to user: A question that the agent asks the user.
descriptions.Agent output > Claim / decision: A claim, a decision, an estimate or an assessment that the agent states.
descriptions.Agent action: What the agent does: a tool call, a command, a git command, a file operation, a call to a skill or a subagent.
descriptions.Agent action > Tool call: A tool call or tool invocation of any kind.
descriptions.Agent action > Shell command: A shell, bash or CLI command.
descriptions.Agent action > Git command: A git command or git operation.
descriptions.Agent action > File operation: A file write, edit, move or delete operation as an action.
descriptions.Agent action > Skill / subagent call: A call to a skill or a subagent, or a delegation.
descriptions.User input: What the user gives the agent: a request, a prompt, a task.
descriptions.User input > Request / prompt: A user request, prompt, message or input.
descriptions.User input > Task / ticket: A task, a ticket, a story or a work item.
descriptions.Agent setup: The agent's own setup: instruction files, skills, agent definitions, memory, workflows.
descriptions.Agent setup > Instruction file: A rule or instruction file for the agent, such as CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md.
descriptions.Agent setup > Skill: A skill or its SKILL.md file.
descriptions.Agent setup > Agent / persona: An agent, a subagent or a persona definition.
descriptions.Agent setup > Memory: The agent's memory or a memory file.
descriptions.Agent setup > Workflow: A workflow, its steps, or a handoff between agents.
descriptions.Source code: Code: source files and code units such as functions, classes, components, names, imports.
descriptions.Source code > Class / type: A class, a type, an interface or a struct.
descriptions.Source code > Component: A UI or software component in code (for example a React component).
descriptions.Source code > Name / identifier: A name: a variable, function, file or other identifier.
descriptions.Source code > Import: An import or a module reference in code.
descriptions.Tests: Tests: test cases, test files, assertions.
descriptions.Tests > Test case: A test case or a test.
descriptions.Tests > Test file / suite: A test file or a test suite.
descriptions.Repo / config: Project files that are not source code or docs: config, dependencies, build and CI files, infrastructure, any file or folder.
descriptions.Repo / config > Config file: A configuration or settings file (JSON, YAML, TOML, tsconfig).
descriptions.Repo / config > Dependency / package: A dependency, a package or a library version.
descriptions.Repo / config > Build / CI file: A build script, a Dockerfile, a Makefile or a CI workflow file.
descriptions.Repo / config > Any file / folder: A file, a folder, a path or an artifact of no specific kind.
descriptions.Version control: Version-control objects: commits, commit messages, branches, pull requests, diffs, issues.
descriptions.Version control > Pull request: A pull request, its title or its description.
descriptions.Version control > Diff: A diff, a patch or a code change.
descriptions.Version control > Issue: An issue in an issue tracker.
descriptions.Docs / content: Written content: documentation, sections, code comments, changelogs, prose, templates.
descriptions.Docs / content > Doc file: A documentation file, such as a README or a markdown document.
descriptions.Docs / content > Section / heading: A section, a heading or a part of a document.
descriptions.Docs / content > Code comment: A code comment or a docstring.
descriptions.Docs / content > Prose / copy: Text, prose, wording, copy or an article.
descriptions.Docs / content > Template: A template for documents or content.
descriptions.Runtime data: Data that a running system handles: requests, responses, queries, records, fields, logs, errors, secrets, business objects.
descriptions.Runtime data > Endpoint / request: An API endpoint, a route or an HTTP request.
descriptions.Runtime data > Record / table: Stored data: a database record, a row or a table.
descriptions.Runtime data > Field / value: One field, parameter or value, inside a request, a record or an object.
descriptions.Runtime data > Log entry: A log entry or a log record.
descriptions.Runtime data > Error: An error, an exception or an error message.
descriptions.Runtime data > Secret / credential: A secret, a credential, a token or a password.
descriptions.Runtime data > Domain object: A whole business object: an order, an account, a user, a payment, a product.
descriptions.UI / media: What the user sees: pages, UI elements, images and media, layout and style, accessibility.
descriptions.UI / media > Page / screen: A page, a screen or a view.
descriptions.UI / media > UI element: A UI element: a button, a form, a card, a menu, a link.
descriptions.UI / media > Image / media: An image, a video, audio or another media file.
descriptions.UI / media > Layout / style: Layout, styling, fonts, colours or CSS rules.
descriptions.UI / media > Accessibility: Accessibility attributes, labels or alt text.
descriptions.Other: None of the options above fits.
